title: Does a refused release decision have an attestation, as the Gate decision's field Attestation says?
description: The field Attestation of ST-ASR-EN03 Gate decision says: where the signed decision is kept; a release decision always has one. ST-ASR-INV09 and ST-ASR-UC03-R03 say that a passed release decision is attested, and the release gate as built hands only a passed decision to the attestation action: a refused release decision fails the gate-release job, writes no predicate, and the attest-release job does not run, so it has no attestation. Option A (proposed, and what the code does): change the field's meaning to say that a passed release decision always has one, and that a refused decision or a change decision has none. Option B: a refused release decision is attested too, so that release qualification can see why a commit was refused; then INV09 and UC03-R03 change, the attest-release job runs for a refused decision, and the predicate holds its reasons.
